name: global-climate-2015-features
title: Global model rerun with 2015-2026 climate features (0m/3m/6m/12m)
description: Fork the deep-feature weight-decay global pipeline with a features-only change: engineer features from climate_2015_2026_MODELING_READY.csv (seasonal) and climate_monthly_2015_2026_MODELING_READY.csv (monthly), rerun global 0m/3m/6m/12m annual-holdout metrics, and compare to the existing global baselines. No Somalia local model.
creator: William Shi
